SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_period,
  SUM(f.gross_amount) as web_sales_gross
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND d.fiscal_period IN (4, 5, 6)
  AND f.channel_code = 'WB'
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period

  MAX(f.sale_date) as last_sale
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND d.fiscal_period IN (4, 5, 6)
  AND f.channel_code = 'WB'
GROUP BY d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_period,
  f.channel_code,
  c.channel_name,
  SUM(f.gross_amount) as sales_gross
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
INNER JOIN dim_channel c ON f.channel_id = c.channel_id
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND d.fiscal_period IN (4, 5, 6)
  AND c.channel_group = 'web'
GROUP BY d.fiscal_period, f.channel_code, c.channel_name
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period, f.channel_code
